description.narrative: The project will include both the exchange of staff and final year students from Patandi Teachers’ College of special needs education (PTC), Tanzania, and staff from the social educator [vernepleier] study programme at Molde University College (HiMolde), Norway. The students gather information, work-up knowledge and learn about CRC and CRPD. Based on joint knowledge students collaborate about developing educational material (such as films, posters, leaflets or role plays about rights in practice) targeting children and staff in schools for children with special needs. The participants contribute to practical implementation of CRC and CRPD by presenting knowledge to children and staff in the practicing field, and by communicating with them about current practices and how CRC and CRPD can be put into practice. In addition to physical exchange of staff/students, the project also involves several forms of digital knowledge exchange and collaboration, such as meetings, lectures and workshops, including students and staff at both organisations.
